## Summary

Describe the task and why it is needed. Link the requirement id (FR1 to FR5) when there is one.

## Test plan

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run test`
- [ ] Manual path, if the change is visible in the browser

## Checklist

- [ ] The pull request does one thing and targets `develop`
- [ ] Validation and role checks are unchanged or updated on purpose
- [ ] No secrets, `.env` files, or real student data
- [ ] Docs updated when a route, field, or screen changed
- [ ] Unfinished work is marked `TODO(member-N)`
- [ ] Screenshot or short click path for UI changes
